notes.title: Quick Hotfix for Spinning Blade Artifact
notes.notes:
Spinning Blade ("Attacking Provides a Stacking Speed Buff Until the End of Combat") was previously 'remembering' the total speed gained across an entire run, removing that value at the end of every combat. So if a character gained 5 speed during a combat they would lose that speed at the end of the fight. Then during the next fight if they gained another 5 speed they would now lose 10 speed at the end of the fight resulting in a net loss that only got worse as the run progressed.

It now behaves as intended, removing only the speed that was gained during the current battle.

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
There was a progression blocking bug preventing players from leaving the first boss fight after successfully defeating it.

This was embarrassingly one of the same bugs that caused the original delay that I had fixed, but I apparently managed to reimplement it while addressing other issues.

The problem should now be resolved and progress should be possible. If you're encountering this issue be sure that you're on the latest update by closing and re-opening Steam.
